cards.text: VEL-MERIDIAN-ORGANIZED X5 — SHIPPED, OMNI-ANIMATED

cards.title: CONCEPT
cards.text: Five finished 15.3s vertical ads for the Meridian, mirroring the Zede "Stop rummaging" structure. Each cut has its own creator, room, colorway, props, script and voice. The two beats that carry motion, the hand packing and the walk, are animated through Google Omni; the two hero-product bookends stay Ken Burns because product beats never go to a video engine and the reference shoots both as locked static shots anyway. All ten Omni clips passed construction QA with zero re-rolls. Voiceover is ElevenLabs v3 Creative, one voice per cut, all five verified word for word against script by speech to text. Files are in the product's video folder, ready to upload. STILL BLOCKED ON INVENTORY: every colorway is oversold, roughly 1,760 units.

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: Hook line lands. Captions in at 0.47s, lower third.
The bag closed on a real surface in a real room, slow push in.

cards.title: EMOTION
cards.text:
Flat interrupt.

KEN BURNS, deliberately. Hero-product beats never go to a video engine, and the reference shoots this one as a locked static shot, so nothing is lost.

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: The mechanism line lands over the action.

ANIMATED. Overhead into the open bag by a window. Her hand lowers the item the rest of the way into the half beside the centre zip, releases it, and withdraws from frame. The bag holds still, the zip stays visible throughout.

cards.title: EMOTION
cards.text:
Relief. The proof is the action, not the description.

OMNI i2v, 10s trimmed to 3.5s from an in-point of 0.20s. This is the beat the whole ad runs on and the one the first pass got wrong.

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: Longer cuts land their payoff phrase over the first second here.

ANIMATED. The same woman from behind, walking away down the corridor at an even pace, hair and clothes moving with her stride, the bag swaying on its single shoulder strap. Camera follows behind at bag height with a handheld bounce.

cards.title: EMOTION
cards.text:
Quiet aspiration.

OMNI i2v, trimmed from an in-point of 0.50s. Never worn as a backpack in any cut.

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: No captions.
The bag closed again, side on, slow push in. Then black SHOP NOW, then the wordmark.

cards.title: EMOTION
cards.text:
Settled, clean stop.

KEN BURNS, same reasoning as B1. Type and both end cards burned in post.

cards.title: THE BUILD — what each beat is and where it came from  ·  reference: https://app.trendtrack.io/share/ads/zede-BHeCcJ

cards.text: ORG-01 · black · Claire

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: "Stop rummaging. This bag is organized by design."
Walnut desk, laptop behind. Dark shoulder-length hair, black knit, grey trousers.

cards.title: EMOTION
cards.text:
Flat interrupt.

The reference line verbatim. Paired with black on purpose: it is the only script that never names the zip, and black is the colorway whose interior reads darkest.
ORG-02 · brown · Cassidy

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: "Stop digging. This bag zips down the middle."
Marble kitchen counter, coffee mug. Hair tied back, rust knit, indigo jeans.

cards.title: EMOTION
cards.text:
Blunt interrupt, morning, on the way out.

Clearest zip of the five and the tightest copy-to-picture match. Watch this one if the mechanism is what is being tested.
ORG-03 · coffee brown · Brenda

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: "Your keys are buried in there. In this bag they have their own side."
Oak hall bench by the front door, keys and a card wallet on the table. Cream cardigan, dark denim.

cards.title: EMOTION
cards.text:
Recognition, leaving the house.

The line says keys and the keys are physically in frame while she packs.
ORG-04 · taupe · Bella

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: "Everything in your bag is touching everything else. This one is split down the middle."
Walnut table and windowsill. Blonde, dark green tee and skirt.

cards.title: EMOTION
cards.text:
The most physical description of the problem in the set.

The original set, closest of the five to the reference's own rooms. The pile is only ever described in the voice, never shown as another bag.
ORG-05 · cream · Clara

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: "Your laptop is sitting right on your keys. In this bag they sit on separate sides."
Linen bedspread by a window. Blonde low bun, pale blue shirt, off-white trousers.

cards.title: EMOTION
cards.text:
Specific enough to sting if she carries a laptop.

Longest read at 6.53s. The laptop claim is the one the live product page already makes.

cards.title: THE FIVE CUTS — finished, in the video folder  ·  VEL-MERIDIAN-ORGANIZED-X5

cards.text: NOTES

cards.title: Omni QA, zero re-rolls
cards.text: All ten clips checked frame by frame for construction drift: rolled handles, centre turn-lock, both side buckles, silver feet, single-colour leather, no logos. None mutated. What held it was a verbatim construction-lock paragraph in every motion prompt plus an explicit instruction that the bag itself stays completely still on the packing beat. Omni's native audio is discarded and our own voiceover and music bed go over the cut.

cards.title: Voice
cards.text: ElevenLabs v3 on the Creative setting, a different voice per cut: Claire, Cassidy, Brenda, Bella, Clara. Each read generated inside a longer passage and sliced out on its own word timings. All five finished mixes were run back through speech to text and every one matches its script word for word.

cards.title: Captions
cards.text: Rolling three-line stack in the lower third, the spoken phrase bright and its neighbours dimmed, cut to each read's own word timings. Sitting low so they never cover the hand or the zip during the demo.

cards.title: BLOCKER, inventory
cards.text: The creative is done. This is the only thing between it and a launch. Every colorway is oversold and still selling on continue-selling: Coffee Brown -459, Brown -376, Taupe -352, Midnight Black -275, Cream -161, Burgundy -139. Roughly 1,760 units of backorder. Run these behind a restock date, or point them at a pre-order page that states the ship date.

cards.title: Spend
cards.text: 20 keyframes at 6 credits each, 120 on kie. Omni animation runs on the Gemini key, not kie credits. No re-rolls were needed on either stage.

cards.title: Still open
cards.text: Burgundy is a sixth cut away (four keyframes, two Omni clips, one voice render). Dimensions are still unpublished so no measurements are spoken anywhere; confirm the laptop size it fits and ORG-05 can name it. Birkin-inspired stays out until you say otherwise, and would be voiceover only, never a generation prompt.
